question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **‘are leading’ (Option 3)**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is “indigenous peoples”, which is "plural".
 
• Therefore, the verb used must also be in a "plural form".
 
• Among the given options, “are leading” is the only grammatically correct plural verb phrase.
 
• The sentence expresses an ongoing action, which also suits the present continuous structure: “are leading efforts.”

Therefore, the correct answer is **‘Option 3’**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **has leading** — Incorrect because “has” is singular, but the subject is plural.
 
• **have leading** — Grammatically awkward; “have” does not pair naturally with “leading” in this structure.
 
• **was leading** — Incorrect tense and singular form.
